prereg_correction.reason: The initial preregistration did not define the exact empirical-percentile rank mapping and a 252-feature-observation minimum would exclude required early-2021 taxonomy windows because the immutable P5.2 panel begins 2020-10-01.
prereg_correction.change: Freeze an exact average-rank percentile formula, a 365 completed-date maximum window, a 20 nonmissing-feature-observation minimum, DATA_INSUFFICIENT pre-initialization semantics, and mandatory calibration-depth reporting.

transition_prereg_correction.reason: The initial preregistration did not fully specify ordinary escalation/de-escalation counter mechanics or initialization, and two listed runtime inputs were not referenced by any frozen evidence atom.
transition_prereg_correction.change: Freeze exact severity-index hysteresis mechanics, initialization/reset behavior, partial-missing behavior, and remove unused BNB/BTC40 and daily-RSI14 runtime inputs rather than leaving dead inputs in the state engine.

scope: P5.3 research state classification and transition structure only. No production authorization and no P5.4 gross-risk multiplier selection.

state_semantics.NORMAL_BULL: Constructive regime without sufficient maturity, rotation, exhaustion or damage evidence to enter a later-cycle state.
state_semantics.BTC_LEADERSHIP_MATURING: BTC remains structurally constructive but regime texture indicates late/mature conditions; rotation evidence is not yet sufficient and this state is not bearish by itself.
state_semantics.LATE_BULL_ROTATION: BTC remains structurally viable while ETH/alt leadership and breadth rotation strengthen. Rotation may coexist with lower future total risk but is not itself an exit signal.
state_semantics.EXHAUSTION_WATCH: Multi-family exhaustion/transition evidence is present without sufficient confirmed damage for de-risk states.
state_semantics.DE_RISK_1: Exhaustion plus moderate structural damage or persistent multi-family hazard supports the first de-risk state.
state_semantics.DE_RISK_2: Stronger or persistent multi-family exhaustion and structural damage supports a more conservative de-risk state.
state_semantics.FLAT: Hard-risk state with zero directional exposure semantics. The research classifier may enter FLAT on the frozen hard-risk rule; automatic exit from FLAT is forbidden.

causal_normalization.window_semantics: At date t take the last up to 365 completed daily dates ending at t, then drop missing values for the feature being normalized.
causal_normalization.percentile_range: [0,1] with sample minimum=0 and sample maximum=1 when N>1
causal_normalization.early_history_rule: When 20 <= N < 365, use the available causal nonmissing feature history and report N. When N < 20, that normalized feature is unavailable.
causal_normalization.initialization_rule: The P5.3 state path remains DATA_INSUFFICIENT until every continuous runtime feature used by any evidence atom has at least 20 nonmissing observations under the causal window. DATA_INSUFFICIENT rows are reported and excluded from ordinary state-occupancy denominators.

raw_fraction_inputs.canonical5_outperformance_breadth_20d: Use the raw [0,1] breadth fraction in ROTATION; do not percentile-normalize it for the 0.75 threshold.

MATURE_TEXTURE.rule: At least 2 of: btc_rv20_ann <= moderate_low; btc_rv20_to_rv60 <= moderate_low; btc_distance_from_90d_high >= moderate_high; btc_kama_gap >= 0.50 percentile.
MATURE_TEXTURE.purpose: Late/mature regime texture only; never sufficient for de-risk.

ROTATION.rule: eth_btc_log_return_20d >= moderate_high AND at least 1 of: eth_btc_log_return_40d >= moderate_high; breadth_acceleration_10d >= moderate_high; canonical5_outperformance_breadth_20d >= 0.75 raw fraction.
ROTATION.purpose: Identify late-bull leadership migration without treating it as bearish.

EXHAUSTION.rule: At least 2 independent subchannels are active: divergence (price-rsi divergence >= moderate_high); momentum failure (rsi14 failure >= moderate_high OR both 4h RSI14 and 4h RSI28 >= moderate_high); breadth transition (breadth contraction >= moderate_high OR breadth acceleration <= moderate_low).
EXHAUSTION.purpose: Require multi-family transition evidence rather than raw RSI alone.

STRONG_EXHAUSTION.rule: price-rsi divergence >= strong_high AND at least 1 additional exhaustion subchannel is active at moderate threshold, OR at least 3 exhaustion subchannels are active at moderate threshold.
STRONG_EXHAUSTION.purpose: Stronger exhaustion evidence, still requiring more than one indicator.

DAMAGE.rule: At least 2 of: btc_kama_gap <= moderate_low; btc_distance_from_90d_high <= moderate_low; btc_log_return_20d <= moderate_low; btc_log_return_40d <= moderate_low.

STRONG_DAMAGE.rule: At least 2 TREND_DAMAGE inputs <= strong_low, including at least one of btc_kama_gap or btc_distance_from_90d_high.
STRONG_DAMAGE.purpose: Harder trend damage used for stronger de-risk / hard-risk paths.

raw_candidate_state_priority.rule: STRONG_DAMAGE AND EXHAUSTION, OR DAMAGE AND STRONG_EXHAUSTION

transition_rules.state_index: Use severity_order zero-based indices for all later/earlier comparisons.
transition_rules.initialization: On the first date when all required continuous runtime inputs are calibrated, evaluate the raw candidate. If it is FLAT, initialize FLAT immediately; otherwise initialize NORMAL_BULL with escalation_count=0 and deescalation_count=0.
transition_rules.ordinary_escalation_condition: When raw_index > current_index, increment an escalation streak only while every consecutive initialized date continues to have raw_index > current_index. Reset the streak whenever raw_index <= current_index or current_state changes.
transition_rules.ordinary_escalation_target: After profile.escalation_persistence_days consecutive dates above current_state, set current_state to the minimum-severity raw candidate observed over that persistence window. This is the strongest state continuously supported by every date in the window. Multi-state jumps are permitted only to that continuously supported minimum. Reset both counters after the transition.
transition_rules.hard_flat: If the fully evaluated raw candidate is FLAT, enter FLAT immediately without ordinary persistence.
transition_rules.ordinary_deescalation_condition: When raw_index < current_index and current_state is not FLAT, increment a deescalation streak only while every consecutive initialized date remains below current_index. Reset the streak whenever raw_index >= current_index or current_state changes.
transition_rules.ordinary_deescalation_target: After profile.deescalation_clear_days consecutive dates below current_state, move exactly one severity_order step lower and reset both counters. Every further deescalation step therefore requires a fresh clear period.
transition_rules.equal_candidate: When raw_index == current_index, reset both escalation and deescalation counters and hold current_state.
transition_rules.missing_data: Before initialization emit DATA_INSUFFICIENT. After initialization, if any input required for ordinary raw-candidate evaluation is missing, hold current_state and reset ordinary transition counters. A hard FLAT escalation is still allowed only if every normalized/raw input needed to prove both STRONG_DAMAGE and STRONG_EXHAUSTION is present and those atoms are true; otherwise missing data cannot change state.
transition_rules.intraday: No P5.3 intraday risk addition. Intraday emergency risk reduction remains governed by existing execution/risk controls.

research_outputs_required: daily state path for EARLY/BALANCED/CONSERVATIVE profiles
raw candidate state and evidence-atom booleans by date/profile
per-feature normalization observation count and minimum calibration depth by date
DATA_INSUFFICIENT date range and initialization date
event-window state occupancy and first-entry dates
lead/lag relative to frozen P5.1 anchors

selection_rule.rule: P5.3 may identify a research candidate/profile for downstream P5.4/P5.5, but no profile may be production-authorized and no profile may be selected solely because it best predicts the sole 2021 terminal event. Robustness selection belongs to P5.5 after behavior/economic mapping is defined.

forbidden: add a post-result feature because it improves 2021 November
use robust-z versus controls as a live feature input
use future observations in trailing normalization
treat ETH/BTC or alt leadership alone as bearish
treat raw RSI alone as a top switch
treat low volatility alone as a top switch
